declarations.name: Badge
declarations.description: A small status label. The slotted text is the name, and it is not a control.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Status color.

slots.description: The status text. It is the accessible name.

declarations.name: Banner
declarations.description: A page-level message with a status. The slotted text is the message.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Status of the message.

slots.description: The message. It is the accessible name.

declarations.name: Breadcrumbs
declarations.description: Shows the path back through the site. The current page is the last item and is not a link.

slots.description: List items. Earlier items contain a link. The last item is the current page.

declarations.name: Button
declarations.description: Starts an action. The label is the slotted text, and the control participates in the nearest form.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Visual emphasis. Primary is the page's main action.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Target height. Medium is 44px.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Removes the control from the tab order and blocks activation.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Form behavior. Submit and reset use the host's associated form.

slots.description: Accessible name. Keep this text visible.

events.name: click
events.description: Native click from the inner button, including Enter and Space.

declarations.name: Card
declarations.description: Groups one subject on a surface. A heading, a body, optional media on top, and actions in the footer. With an href, the whole card is a link named by its heading.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Surface treatment. Raised floats on the canvas, outlined draws a boundary, filled sits flat on a tint.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Makes the whole card a link to this destination. The heading is the link text.

slots.description: Body text.

slots.name: heading
slots.description: The title, usually an h2 or h3. Required when href is set, because it names the link.

slots.name: media
slots.description: An image or video shown full bleed at the top. Give an image its alt text, or an empty alt when decorative.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Actions or metadata. Buttons here stay clickable on a link card.

declarations.name: CheckboxCard
declarations.description: A checkbox with room to explain. The whole card toggles the choice, and the value joins the nearest form while checked.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value submitted while checked.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Whether the choice is selected.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Removes the card from the tab order and blocks changes.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form cannot submit until this card is checked.

slots.description: Accessible name, in a few words.

slots.name: description
slots.description: One or two lines that help people choose. It is read as the description.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: An amb-icon, decorative.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when the checked state changes.

declarations.name: Checkbox
declarations.description: Selects a choice that can stand alone. The label is the slotted text, and a checked box joins the nearest form.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form submission name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value submitted while the box is checked.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Whether the choice is selected.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Removes the control from the tab order and blocks toggling.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form cannot submit while the box is unchecked.

slots.description: Accessible name. Keep this text visible.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when the checked state changes.

declarations.name: DatePicker
declarations.description: A date typed in the locale's own format, or picked from a calendar. The value is an ISO date, such as 2026-09-24, and joins the nearest form.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The date as YYYY-MM-DD, or empty.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Earliest date people can pick, as YYYY-MM-DD. Earlier days are struck out in the calendar.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Latest date people can pick, as YYYY-MM-DD.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks typing and the calendar.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form cannot submit without a date.

slots.description: Accessible name. Keep this text visible.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when the date changes, typed or picked.

declarations.name: Dialog
declarations.description: A modal conversation. The slotted content is the message, and the close slot names the dismiss control.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the dialog is shown as a modal.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the dialog.

slots.description: The dialog content. Headings stay native HTML.

slots.name: close
slots.description: Visible name of the button that dismisses the dialog.

events.name: close
events.description: Fired after the dialog closes, including Escape and the backdrop.

declarations.name: Disclosure
declarations.description: Shows or hides a region. The button label is the default slot, and the panel is a named slot.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the panel is shown.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Removes the control from the tab order and blocks toggling.

slots.description: Accessible name of the button. Keep this text visible.

slots.name: panel
slots.description: Content that is shown while the disclosure is open.

events.name: toggle
events.description: Fired after the open state changes. detail.open is the next state.

declarations.name: Icon
declarations.description: Sizes a graphic. An empty label is decorative. A label makes the graphic an image with that name.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Material Symbols Outlined ligature. Leave empty to slot an SVG instead. The product loads the font.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Box size. Small is 16px, medium is 20px, large is 24px.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name. Leave empty when the graphic is decorative.

slots.description: The graphic, usually an SVG. It does not supply the accessible name.

declarations.name: Layout
declarations.description: The page frame. Places a header, navigation, main content, an aside, and a footer in one of three layouts, each a landmark, and adapts to the width it is given.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Sidebar puts the navigation in a column that stays in view. Split sets a list pane beside a detail pane. Stacked centres one reading column under the header.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

slots.description: The main content. It is the main landmark, so use one layout per page.

slots.name: header
slots.description: The top bar, such as the product name, search, and account menu.

slots.name: nav
slots.description: Navigation links in a list, or the list pane in the split layout.

slots.name: aside
slots.description: Related content, such as filters, details, or an outline.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Legal links and secondary information.

declarations.name: Link
declarations.description: Goes somewhere. The label is the slotted text, and the control is a native link.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Destination URL. A link without an href is not a link.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Visual emphasis. Text is the accent link. Quiet is for a secondary destination.

attributes.name: external
attributes.description: Opens the destination in a new browsing context and sets rel to noreferrer.

slots.description: Accessible name. Keep this text visible.

events.name: click
events.description: Native click from the inner link.

declarations.name: Menu
declarations.description: A button that opens a menu of actions. The default slot names the button, and the panel slot holds the actions.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the action list is shown.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Removes the button from the tab order and blocks opening.

slots.description: Visible name of the button that opens the list.

slots.name: panel
slots.description: Native buttons, one action each. Each receives the menuitem role.

events.name: toggle
events.description: Fired after the open state changes. detail.open is the next state.

declarations.name: Message
declarations.description: One turn of a conversation with an assistant. The user's turn is a bubble, the assistant's is open text with an avatar, and a streaming or failed answer shows its state.

attributes.name: from
attributes.description: Who speaks. It sets the side, the shape, and the tint.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Streaming shows a caret and marks the turn busy. Error shows the error line under the text.

slots.description: The text of the turn. Paragraphs, lists, and code blocks are spaced for reading.

slots.name: author
slots.description: Who speaks, such as You or Assistant. It names the turn.

slots.name: avatar
slots.description: An initial, an image, or an amb-icon. It is decorative.

slots.name: error
slots.description: What went wrong, when status is error. A default sentence is used otherwise.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Buttons under the turn, such as copy, retry, or rate.

declarations.name: Pagination
declarations.description: Moves between pages of a list. The slotted links are the pages, and the current one is marked.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the navigation.

slots.description: List items. Each contains a link or a button. Mark the current page with aria-current.

declarations.name: Progress
declarations.description: Shows how much of a task is finished. The label names the task.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Amount finished, from 0 to max.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Amount that means finished.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the task.

declarations.name: Prompt
declarations.description: The composer of a conversation. A field that grows with the text, a send button, and a stop button while an answer is on its way.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name. The text joins the nearest form.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The text in the field. It empties after a send.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: An example of what to ask. It is not the label.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks typing and sending.

attributes.name: busy
attributes.description: An answer is on its way. Sending waits, and the send button becomes a stop button.

slots.description: Accessible name, such as Message. It is visually hidden, because the composer is recognised by its place.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Buttons at the start of the bar, such as attach a file.

events.name: send
events.description: Fired on Enter or the send button with detail.value, the trimmed text. Cancel it to keep the text in the field.

events.name: stop
events.description: Fired when the stop button is pressed while busy.

declarations.name: Quantity
declarations.description: Sets how many of a product to add. The slotted text names the product.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form name submitted with the quantity.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The current quantity.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Smallest allowed quantity.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Largest allowed quantity.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Amount the quantity changes per step.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Removes the control from the tab order and blocks changes.

slots.description: Visible name of the product being counted.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired after the quantity changes. detail.value is the next number.

declarations.name: RadioCard
declarations.description: One choice in a named group, with room to explain. The whole card selects it, and the checked card joins the nearest form.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Group name. Cards that share a name in one form submit a single value.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value submitted while this card is checked.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Whether this choice is selected.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Removes the card from the group's keyboard order and blocks selection.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form cannot submit until one card in the group is checked.

slots.description: Accessible name, in a few words.

slots.name: description
slots.description: The facts people compare, such as the price or the delay. It is read as the description.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: An amb-icon, decorative.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when this card becomes checked.

declarations.name: Radio
declarations.description: Selects one choice in a named group. The label is the slotted text, and the checked radio joins the nearest form.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Group name. Radios that share a name in one form submit a single value.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value submitted while this radio is checked.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Whether this choice is selected.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Removes the control from the tab order and blocks selection.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form cannot submit until one radio in the group is checked.

slots.description: Accessible name. Keep this text visible.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when this radio becomes checked.

declarations.name: Range
declarations.description: Chooses a number between a minimum and a maximum. The slotted text is the label.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form name submitted with the value.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The current number.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Smallest allowed number.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Largest allowed number.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Amount the value changes per step.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Removes the control from the tab order and blocks changes.

slots.description: Visible label. It names the range.

declarations.name: Select
declarations.description: Chooses one option. The label is the slotted text, the options are child option elements, and the value joins the nearest form.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form submission name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Selected option value. This is a property, not a reflected attribute.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Removes the control from the tab order and blocks changes.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form cannot submit until an option with a value is selected.

slots.description: Accessible name. Keep this text visible. Child option elements are the choices, not the name.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when the selected option changes.

declarations.name: Skeleton
declarations.description: Holds the place of content that has not arrived. It is hidden from assistive technology.

slots.description: Optional shape. Leave it empty for a single bar.

declarations.name: Spinner
declarations.description: Shows that content is loading. The label names the wait for assistive technology.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the wait.

declarations.name: StatTile
declarations.description: One key figure with its label, the change since the last period, and a line of context.

attributes.name: trend
attributes.description: Direction of the change. Draws an arrow next to the delta.

attributes.name: sentiment
attributes.description: Whether the change is good or bad news. It colors the delta, separately from the direction.

slots.description: What the figure measures, such as Monthly revenue.

slots.name: value
slots.description: The figure, formatted for the reader, such as 48,210 euros.

slots.name: delta
slots.description: The change in words and numbers, such as 12% more than last month.

slots.name: description
slots.description: One line of context, such as the period.

declarations.name: Suggestion
declarations.description: A prompt people can send in one press, offered before the conversation starts or after an answer.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks the suggestion, for example while an answer is on its way.

slots.description: The prompt, written as people would type it. It is the accessible name.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: An amb-icon in place of the default spark. It is decorative.

events.name: click
events.description: The native click. Send the label text, or fill the prompt with it.

declarations.name: Tabs
declarations.description: Switches between panels. Each tab is a button, and each panel is the matching region.

slots.name: tab
slots.description: One button per panel, in the same order. The button text is the tab name.

slots.name: panel
slots.description: The region shown when the matching tab is selected.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when the selected tab changes. detail.index is the new index.

declarations.name: Tag
declarations.description: Labels an object for recognition. The slotted text is the name, and it is not a control.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Quiet or accent fill.

slots.description: The label text. It is the accessible name.

declarations.name: TextArea
declarations.description: A multi-line field. The slotted text is the label, and the value is the typed text.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form name submitted with the value.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The current text.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Hint shown while the field is empty. It is not a label.

attributes.name: rows
attributes.description: Visible line count of the control.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Removes the control from the tab order and blocks editing.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The field must have a value before the form submits.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: The value can be focused and copied, and it cannot be edited.

slots.description: Visible label. It names the field.

declarations.name: TextField
declarations.description: Collects a single line of text. The label is the slotted text, and the value joins the nearest form.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form submission name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Current text. This is a property, not a reflected attribute.

attributes.name: type
attributes.type: text | email | password | search | tel | url
attributes.description: Native input type.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Hint shown when the value is empty. It is not the label.

attributes.name: autocomplete
attributes.description: Autofill hint. Set it when the field collects a person's own data.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Removes the control from the tab order and blocks editing.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form cannot submit while the value is empty.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: The value can be read and submitted, and it cannot be edited.

slots.description: Accessible name. Keep this text visible.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when the field commits a value.

declarations.name: Thinking
declarations.description: Says the assistant is working before the first words arrive. The label names the step, such as Reading the invoices.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: What the assistant is doing, in a few words. It is announced politely when it changes.

declarations.name: Tile
declarations.description: A compact entry point in a grid. An icon, a short title, and a line of description. With an href, the whole tile is a link named by its title.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Makes the whole tile a link to this destination. The title is the link text.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: Color of the icon well. Use accent for the one tile to start with.

slots.description: The title, in a few words. It names the link when href is set.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: An amb-icon. It is decorative, so give it no label.

slots.name: description
slots.description: One short line under the title.

slots.name: meta
slots.description: A count or a badge in the top corner.

declarations.name: Toggle
declarations.description: A switch between two states. The slotted text is the label, and checked is the on state.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form name submitted when the switch is on.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Form value submitted when the switch is on.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Whether the switch is on.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Removes the control from the tab order and blocks toggling.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The switch must be on before the form submits.

slots.description: Visible label. It names the switch.

declarations.name: Tooltip
declarations.description: A short description that appears on hover and focus of the slotted control.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: The description. It is the accessible name of the tip.

slots.description: The control the tip describes. One focusable element.
